caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden box with a dark brown finish, viewed from a slightly elevated angle, showing the front and right side. The box has a flat lid with a slightly projecting edge and smooth surfaces on the top and right side. The front panel features a decorative carved design composed of symmetrical, stylized plant or floral motifs arranged in two rows within a rectangular border. The carved area is slightly recessed compared to the unornamented panels. The background of the drawing is a plain, off-white or light beige color, and the artist's name, ISIDORE SOVENSKY, is printed in small capital letters in the lower right corner.
title: Box
